name: Dread Lash
description: Bring a charged lash down with such weight that the struck guard folds back on its owner.

name: Fell Bolt
description: Loose a heavy bolt that carries the shock of a falling tree into a single target.

name: Dread Ward
description: Cloak the body in a thick shell of charge that makes foes hesitate to strike it.

name: Heavy Stride
description: Stride forward with each footfall a thunderclap that drives the user a long pace.

name: Ruin Spear
description: Hurl a spear of lightning that drives through guard, plate and the body behind them.

name: Doom Peal
description: Sound a deep peal of thunder that rolls over the ground and cracks the stance of all upon it.

name: Cleaving Arc
description: Swing a vast arc of charge across the front that cleaves everything in its sweep.

name: Rending Fork
description: Throw a forked bolt whose two prongs tear a guard apart from either side.

name: Annihilating Fork
description: Drive a great fork of lightning through the foe's guard, body and the ground beneath.

name: Obliterating Peal
description: Loose a peal of such force that it flattens nearby foes and splits the ground around the user.

name: Vanishing Strike
description: Vanish in a flash of lightning and reappear at the foe's back, already striking.

name: Ruinous Descent
description: School cast in which a bolt of the thrower's own measure falls from a height on the whole field of foes.

name: Thunder Cataclysm
description: Call down a storm of thunder at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier, ruining everything in its reach.

name: Grim Lash
description: Lash from the core with a grim weight that bruises through the hardest guard.

name: Bleak Bolt
description: Loose a pale, bleak bolt that strikes without a flash and leaves a numb scorch.

name: Grim Ward
description: Wear a close shell drawn from the core that does not yield to even the heaviest blow.

name: Grim Pace
description: Cross the ground in huge steps, each driven by a pulse from the core.

name: Wrathful Fork
description: Throw a forked bolt hot with wrath that sears through shield and plate.

name: Raging Peal
description: Roar a raging peal of thunder over a wide ground that tears at footing and nerve.

name: Core Rend
description: Smash a fist loaded with the core's charge into a target and tear a guard apart.

name: Rent Arc
description: Rip a long arc across the front in a single stroke that rends all in front of it.

name: Hollowing Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that passes through armour and flesh to burn the nerves inside and leave the foe hollow.

name: Shattering Peal
description: Sound a peal that shatters the guards and shields of all foes in a wide ring.

name: Cataclysmic Lash
description: Bring down a lash so heavy that the struck foe is pressed to the ground and cannot rise.

name: Ruinous Core
description: School cast in which the formed core is opened and its stored thunder spills over the foe.

name: Core Cataclysm
description: Release the core's whole stored thunder at the destructive ceiling of its tier, devastating the ground ahead.

name: Core Devastation
description: Focus the core's thunder into one lance that devastates all in a line at the ceiling of its tier.

name: Regal Lash
description: Lash with a sovereign's weight so that those struck drop to a knee.

name: Crowned Bolt
description: Loose a bolt crowned in white fire that punishes those who raise a hand against its caster.

name: Imperial Ward
description: Wrap the body in a divine shell of lightning that turns almost any blow.

name: Majestic Stride
description: Stride across a field of foes in a few steps, lightning leaping from each footfall.

name: Dominion Spear
description: Command a spear of lightning to drive through every guard between the user and the mark.

name: Dominion Peal
description: Decree a peal of thunder that silences and scatters all foes within its range.

name: Edict Fork
description: Issue a forked bolt as a command, piercing the foe and sealing a casting hand shut.

name: Thunder Edict
description: Smash down a decree of thunder on a single target and break its stance in one blow.

name: Tyrant Bolt
description: Cast a bolt of absolute authority that burns through every guard into the foe's nerves.

name: Thunder Judgment
description: Pass judgment on a single foe with a stroke that no guard can turn.

name: Verdict Peal
description: Sound a verdict of thunder over a wide ground and bring all within to their knees.

name: Crowned Thunder
description: School cast in which a crown of lightning forms over the thrower and breaks upon the foe.

name: Dominion Decree
description: School cast in which the thrower decrees silence and a heavy thunder presses all foes to the ground.

name: Unmaking Thunder
description: Unmake the ground under a host in one boundless thunder at the full destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Crowning Calamity
description: Crown the user in lightning and loose a calamity that bores through everything in its path to the tier's ceiling.
